children: Canada’s manufacturing sales advance estimates indicate that total manufacturing sales increased 1.1% month-over-month in August 2026, after falling 0.4% in July.
If confirmed, this would be the sharpest increase since May.
The advance results indicate that the largest increases were recorded in the primary metal and chemical subsectors.

title: Canada Manufacturing Sales Seen Rebounding in August
